name: Grant Taylor
bio: Grant has experience with governance, audit, and risk across community organisations.
longBio:
Grant Brendon Taylor is a board member with governance, audit, and risk experience across community organisations. He has advised not-for-profits on financial stewardship and compliance, helping teams stay focused on their mission while meeting funder obligations.

Grant cares deeply about safe, sustainable services for rangatahi and brings a steady hand to Kick Back's oversight and planning.
